rows.grounds: compound of sadāśiva, ādi, tattva, and ugha; fused form retained as given
compound of nitya, upādāna, and kāraṇa; nominative singular masculine

items.question: Is the group of principles beginning with Sadāśiva the eternal material cause?
premises: The verse names a principle group.
It calls that group eternal material cause.
items.inference: Therefore the principle group beginning with Sadāśiva is the eternal material cause.
uncertainties: Exact scope of ādi within the compound.
Whether ugha functions as subject or predicate.
items.plain_english: The group of principles beginning with Sadāśiva is the eternal material cause.
